business_model.sells: The StraightScale Client Engine, a 12-month growth and paid acquisition partnership in three packages (contract order form, 19 Oct 2026). All packages: business diagnosis and 12-month growth plan, sales offer build, market and competitor research, Google Business Profile, digital courses in English (Silver 7 learning tracks, Gold and Diamond 15), a sales presentation, Meta ads management with a managed media budget (Silver up to EUR 1,000, Gold up to EUR 5,000, Diamond up to EUR 10,000 a month; ad spend excluded), ad creatives (Silver 8, Gold 16, Diamond 24 a month) and performance reports (Silver quarterly, Gold and Diamond monthly). Gold and Diamond add organic video content (8 and 16 a month), brand identity and brand book, a conversion website (up to 5 and 8 pages), CRM, ad performance tracking, lead follow-up automations by email, SMS and WhatsApp (2 and 5 flows), AI video ads within the creatives (4 and 8 a month) and social media management. Diamond adds Google Search ads management, the AI chatbot and priority support.
business_model.price_notes: Internal only, never in content: Silver EUR 1,290, Gold EUR 1,790, Diamond EUR 2,490 a month, 12 payments (contract order form, 19 Oct 2026). Prices exclude VAT, ad spend, messaging and third-party costs. The full price is owed on signing, in 12 instalments secured by a promissory note; the contract says results are not guaranteed. The contract closes DP-11: organic video is Silver none, Gold 8, Diamond 16 a month.
business_model.capacity: About 10 new client businesses this month (Matan, 19 Oct 2026, for October 2026), limited by service capacity, not a fixed cap; recheck monthly.
business_model.sales_process: Comment ANALIZA -> DM (hub funnel analiza) -> free 45-minute analysis at the office in Tirana or at the client's business, no obligation -> proposal. OS v1 8.5 proposes an application with a EUR 50 deposit: not decided (see decisions).
